## Original prompt

```text
Preserve the subject’s likeness and surroundings from the reference image, restyled as a candid 1970-1975 slide portrait: era-appropriate sunglasses and accessories, dated fashion, early-70s hair, and environmental details updated to match. Add warm faded reds, slightly crushed blacks, fine analog film grain and a soft vignette. Give it the slightly yellowed, sun-bleached tone of an old family slide, with gentle color shifts in the shadows.
```
